git-commit.name: Git Commit Message Generator
git-commit.description: Generates a conventional commit message from staged git changes using an LLM. Outputs plain text to stdout and copies to clipboard. Registers an optional after_implement hook to run automatically after each /speckit.implement session.
git-commit.author: fuongz

commands.name: speckit.git-commit.suggest-commit
commands.description: Inspect staged git changes and recent commit history, then generate a conventional commit message via LLM. Prints result to stdout and copies to clipboard if a clipboard utility is available.

hooks.description: Automatically suggest a commit message after each /speckit.implement session completes. Optional — disable in your speckit config if not needed.

sqlite-sync.name: SQLite Shared Sync
sqlite-sync.description: Maintains a shared SQLite database of all speckit features for your team. Stores full spec file content on every sync so teammates can restore any feature's complete lifecycle files. Syncs feature status and content on init and after each speckit lifecycle command via optional hooks.
sqlite-sync.author: fuongz

commands.name: speckit.sqlite-sync.init
commands.description: Initialize or re-sync the shared SQLite database from the configured path. Creates schema if new, pulls existing team features, and pushes any local features not yet in the shared file.

commands.name: speckit.sqlite-sync.sync
commands.description: Push the current feature's status to the shared SQLite and/or pull the latest team state. Used by lifecycle hooks and can be invoked manually at any time.

hooks.description: After /speckit.specify, records the new feature with status 'draft' in the shared database.
After /speckit.plan, updates the feature status to 'planning' in the shared database.
After /speckit.tasks, updates the feature status to 'tasks' in the shared database.
After /speckit.implement, updates the feature status to 'implementing' in the shared database.

teammate-sync.name: Teammate Sync
teammate-sync.description: Sync your speckit project state with teammates using portable YAML snapshots — no server, no daemon, no real-time sync required. Export your specs/ directory into a single YAML file, share it via any method, and teammates can import it with interactive conflict resolution. Includes a diff/preview command.
teammate-sync.author: fuongz

commands.name: speckit.teammate-sync.export
commands.description: Export the entire specs/ directory into a portable YAML snapshot file. Saved to the configured shared_sync_folder (default: .specify/sync/). Tracks files by stable UUID for accurate conflict detection across renames.

commands.name: speckit.teammate-sync.import
commands.description: Import a teammate's YAML snapshot into the local specs/ directory. Merges non-conflicting changes automatically; presents an interactive [L]/[T]/[S] prompt for conflicts. Atomic — no partial writes on failure.

commands.name: speckit.teammate-sync.diff
commands.description: Preview what would change if a snapshot were imported, without modifying any local files. Shows +/~/!/= markers with a summary count.

hooks.description: After /speckit.implement, automatically export a snapshot to the configured shared_sync_folder. Enable by setting auto_export: true in config.
